agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on Wednesday January 28, 2026 in Built Heritage Committee Report 28.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Wednesday, January 21, 2026, and the deadline to register by email to speak is 8:30 am on Thursday, January 22, 2026.

sub_agendas_items.description:
File No. ACS2026-PDB-RHU-0011    Rideau-Rockcliffe (13)
The statutory 90-day timeline for consideration of this application under the Ontario Heritage Act will expire on February 23, 2026.
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
The Committee received a slide presentation from Ms Taylor Quibell, Planner II, Planning, Development and Building Services (PDBS) Department, which served as an overview of the report.  A copy of this presentation is held on file with the Office of the City Clerk.  Ms Lesley Collins, Program Manager, Heritage Planning, PDBS, was also present to respond to questions.
André Godin had been registered to speak before Committee to respond to questions, if required, but opted not to when asked if he needed to speak if Committee were prepared to ‘Carry’ the item on consent.
Correspondence was received from Linda Hoad, Heritage Ottawa Advocacy Committee, and is held on file with the Office of the City Clerk.
Following questions to staff, and with Committee discussions having concluded, the report recommendations were put before Committee and were ‘Carried’, as presented.

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
With the will of the Committee, the requirement for a report under sub-section 83(4) of the Procedure By-Law was waived in order to receive a staff presentation with up-to-date information on the Heritage Watch List.
The Committee then received a verbal update, accompanied by a slide presentation, from Ms Lesley Collins, Program Manager, Heritage Planning, Planning, Development and Building Services Department.  A copy of this presentation is held on file with the Office of the City Clerk.
